notes: τοῦτο takes *This is* under rule 68's substantival-demonstrative subject clause, which names this configuration expressly against rule 53's general adjectival-predicate clause.

ἐνώπιον keeps the whole frame *in the sight of* headed on *sight* under rules 71 and 95, the trailing *of* riding with the frame as at REV.14.10, so the following article is owed no *of the* under rule 21.
τοῦ is `unrepresented` under rule 20: ἡμῶν occupies the determiner slot with *our* and is spent on nothing else, so rule 76's availability test leaves the article empty.
θεοῦ and σωτῆρος are split onto their own English words rather than sharing a head (rules 26, 28), despite the ASV's reordering.
